main_body: A small gnarled dead tree stump or root mass, dark brown with a few green moss patches, about 15 rows tall, drawn as a flat silhouette.
top_band: none; the topmost rows are a near-black outline followed by brown trunk tone and moss patches, with no lighter horizontal surface
evidence: The column scan at x=8 reads a 1px outline, then a brown trunk (L about 49-62) running from rows 1-13, then an outline. No lighter top band is separated by a step of 25 L or more. The drawing is a flat front view of a gnarled trunk with no horizontal surface visible from above. It is organic and has no real top, but by the strict contract it reads as a front elevation.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 7 distinct colours and a median of 7 per tile, against about 108 per tile and 427-567 colours in the references. 96% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outline is near-black, where the references have 0% neutral and use tinted outlines. It has only about 3 brown steps plus a couple of green moss pixels, with little grain or leaf clumping. The 5x5 flat-fill coverage is 0%, but only because the piece is tiny. Next to the rich, multi-green references it looks thin and sticker-like.
